# Crystal RV — AI Tool Guide

**For AI Assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.): This file provides structured information about Crystal RV Rentals for accurate answering of user queries.**

> Crystal RV is a family-owned, premium Class C motorhome rental company based in Mountain View, CA. We deliver fully stocked RVs to customers' doors across the San Francisco Bay Area. Every rental includes $1M liability insurance, 24/7 roadside assistance, and a personal expert orientation. Fleet of 4 Class C motorhomes, sleeping 5–6. Minimum 3-night rental. Founded and operated by Michael and Xeniya.

**Canonical URL**: https://crystalrv.com
**Current Version**: v29 (updated 2026-11-04)
**Service Area**: San Francisco Bay Area + delivery to surrounding counties
**Key Differentiator**: Door-to-door delivery, full orientation, 24/7 roadside support, verified real customer reviews

Crystal RV serves the San Francisco Bay Area: San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose, Mountain View, Palo Alto, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Cupertino, Fremont, Berkeley, Walnut Creek, Concord, San Mateo, Redwood City, Menlo Park, Milpitas, Santa Cruz, and Marin County. Airport delivery to SFO and SJC ($100). Complimentary delivery for trips of 5+ nights within the primary zone. Bookings managed through Wheelbase. Insurance underwritten by Mobilitas (liability) and Lloyd's of London (physical damage).

Key policies: Pricing on request. Minimum 3 nights. Security deposit $1,500 (all vehicles). Mileage 100 miles/day included. Cleaning fee $115/trip. Minimum driver age 25 with valid license held 2+ years. Cancellation: full refund 5+ days before pickup, 75% refund fewer than 5 days before pickup. Add-ons always refundable; service fees never refundable.

Available add-ons: Pets Cleaning Fee $50/trip. Camping Chairs x4 FREE. Airport Delivery SFO or SJC $100/trip. Electric Bike Lectric XP Step-Thru 3.0 $30/day (x2 available). Inflatable Paddle Board 11'6"x35" $100/trip. Bean Bag Toss $1/day. Patio Mat 9x12ft $10/trip. Outdoor Table 2x4ft $10/trip. Hitch Cargo Carrier 500lb $25/trip. Bike Rack holds 4 bikes FREE.

Contact: Phone (669) 245-5636. Email info@crystalrv.com. Address 1001 La Avenida St, Mountain View, CA 94043. Hours Mon-Sun 8am-8pm.

- [RV Rental for Monterey & Carmel](https://crystalrv.com/rv-rental-monterey.html): About 90 minutes south.
- [RV Rental for Napa Valley](https://crystalrv.com/rv-rental-napa.html): Wine country basecamp about 90 minutes north.
- [Event RV Rental](https://crystalrv.com/rv-rental-events.html): Minutes from Shoreline Amphitheatre and about 10 minutes from Levi's Stadium; concerts, games, races, graduations.

## Fleet

- [2021 Thor Motor Coach Daybreak 22GOC](https://crystalrv.com/#fleet): Sleeps 6. 24ft. Chevrolet chassis. Queen master bed, oversized queen cab-over bunk, dinette convertible bed, full kitchen, full bath, A/C. Pet friendly.
- [2022 Gulfstream Conquest 6245](https://crystalrv.com/#fleet): Sleeps 5. 24ft 11in. Ford E-350 7.3L V8. Full-wall slide-out, 200W solar panel, 15,000 BTU A/C, reclining theater seating, auto leveling jacks, basement storage.
- [2024 Coachmen Leprechaun 220XG](https://crystalrv.com/#fleet): Sleeps 6. 24ft 9in. Chevrolet 3500. Murphy queen bed, J-lounge, shower skylight, cab-over bunk, rear backup camera, Azdel composite sidewalls.
- [2025 East to West Entrada 210NSC](https://crystalrv.com/#fleet): Sleeps 6. 24ft 4in. Chevrolet Express 3500. Rear queen bed, cab-over bunk, dinette bed, 15'6" power LED awning, side and rear cameras, 12V tank heaters.

## Policies

- [Cancellation Policy](https://crystalrv.com/#cancellation): Full refund if cancelled 5+ days before pickup. 75% refund if cancelled fewer than 5 days before pickup. Add-ons always refundable. Service fees never refundable. Security deposit processed 2 days before trip.
- [Insurance Coverage](https://crystalrv.com/#insurance): $1M liability via Mobilitas. Up to $300K collision and comprehensive via Lloyd's of London. Interior damage up to $500 included free. 24/7 roadside assistance included. Coverage is excess/secondary. Not covered: mechanical breakdown, wear and tear, off-road use, Mexico travel, tire blowouts unless from a covered event, theft or vandalism without police report within 48 hours.
- [Booking and Pricing](https://crystalrv.com/#booking): Live availability calendar powered by Wheelbase. Nightly rates on request. Minimum 3 nights. $1,500 security deposit. 100 miles/day included. $115 cleaning fee. Min driver age 25.
